**Wrote 4.2.0 to [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).**

No breaking changes this cycle. One `Added`: webhook deliveries retry with exponential backoff. Ten real `Fixed` items survived out of 380 commits — most were dependency bumps, refactors, and test/CI churn.

Worth a second look: three separate `fix(api): keep the trace id across the retry` commits landed months apart, meaning that bug kept coming back. I merged it into one changelog line, but you may want to check why it regressed twice.

Next: read the drafted notes and adjust wording before you publish.
